title: 02.nfp
description: `02.nfp` demonstrates creating a 1024×768 framebuffer with `gemframebuffer`, texturing it with `grid.jpg`, and displaying it across two `nfp_flat_wall` surfaces and one `nfp_curved_wall` surface. The framebuffer is published through `s nfp_fb`, and the patch provides load/save controls for the projection setup.
